paper.title: Implementing NGSS practices in primary science classrooms: Lessons from an Arab context for advancing global science education

paper.title: Framing the 5% Problem: Teachers' Perspectives on Persistence in Educational Technology

paper.title: Intelligent evaluation and feedback mechanism based on student behavior data in the context of integrated education
